description: Scan the project or its subdirectories, generate packages dependent on CVE loopholes to check information

option.name: Project subdirectories
option.help: A subdirectorial under the project, if not declared, represents the scan of the entire project

option.name: cve Effective test time
option.help: Sets a valid test time for cve, in hours

option.name: Local NVD library Url Modified
option.help: When Mirroring the NVD you must mirror the *.json.gz and the *.meta files.

option.name: Local NVD library URL Base
option.help: URL, Base URL for each year's CVE JSON data feed, the%d will be returned with the year
